(357)rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos rnam pa kun ta

tei:div.tei:p: (357)rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos rnam pa kun tu phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ ji skad du/ yod na sangs rgyas sgrub la des chog cing*/ mdo na sangs rgyas sgrub la thabs chag pa/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa bon ma nor ba/ rnam dag byang chub sems mchog 'byung bar shog ces gsungs pa bzhin/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sa bon ma nor ba rin chen byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di yin pas 'di ci nas rang rgyud la skye ba zhig gal che/ de gang yin na/ rgyal tshab sa bcu'i dbang phyug gis/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ gsungs pa bzhin/ zur dngos snying rje sems can dmigs pa/ zur phyi ma shes rab kyis rdzogs byang la dmigs pa gnyis tshang dgos/ de yang sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te/ rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go (358)'phang la 'god par bya/ da lta bdag la de'i nus pa mi 'dug pas/ des na dang po bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya bsam pa de yin/ theg pa chen po'i don du gnyer bya gzhan don yin pas/ gzhan don de 'jig rten pa'i tshangs pa'ang brgya byin gyi go 'phang thob kyang gzhon don byed mi nus nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob kyang gzhan don chen po byed mi nus/ byang chub sems dpas kyang sems can thams cad kyi don cig char du byed mi nus pas/ sems can gyi don mnyam du byed pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de thob par bya bsam dgos so/ de bsgom pa la/ zur dang po snying rjes sems can la dmigs pa dang zur phyi ma shes rab kyis rjogs byang la dmimags pa gnyis las/ dang po la rang gi rtsa ba'i ma nas ma bsgom na gshis 'byams go yul du shor zhes byang chub kyi sems babasgom pa'i gegs dang go sar 'gyur ba yin pas/

de bsgom pa la/ mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin gzo 'dod kyi (359)rtog pa bskyed pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bskyed pa dang bzhi las/ dang po mar shes pa ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de shi'ang gson na'ang*/ phung khams ci lta bar rang la brtse gdung dang bcas par dmigs nas/ 'di ltar nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab/ sems can gyis gar khyab las snang sdug bsngal gyis khyab/ las snang sdug bsngal gyi mnar ba'i sems can rnams rang gi pha dang ma dang gnyen bshes dang grogs dga' mja' ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ de'i nang nas snying nye ba'i dbang du byas na/ da lta'i rang gi ma 'di bzhin ma byas pa gcig med/ rang gi ma 'dis kyang ma lan gcig byas par ma zad/ ma lan grangs bsam kyi mi khyab par byas pa lus dang rigs pa gnyis kyis sgrub na/ lung ni ma yi thug mtha' zhes rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs nas rang gi ma 'di'i da lta mi'i ma byas dai'i sngon du rta'am bya la sogs pa'i mtha' rang gis sa chen po 'di rgya shugs gi tshig dgu tsam du dril (360)kyang pa chen po 'di zad par 'gyur cing ma gcig gis ma byas pa'i mtha' ma zad pa med/ rigs pas bsgrub na/ sa lag pa tsam gyi steng nas lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par 'chi ma myong pa dang skye ma myong pa med pas lha dang dmyal ba phar cher ma gtogs ma med par mi skye ba sems can thams cad kyis ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas pa yin da lta'i ma 'dis kyang ma lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas pa rnams bsam/ de nas pha dang*/ spun zla sring mo sogs re re nas mar shes pa bsam/ de nas 'jam bu gling gi sems can/ thun gyi 'jug tu nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can rnams la ma lan gcig tsam ma yin par lan grangs mang por byas tshul rnams bsam/ gnyis pa la drin dranapa ni/ 'jig rten gyi lugs dang chos kyi lugs kyi drin dran pa gnyis las/

dang po la bzhi/ dang po lus bskyed pa'i drin ni/ rang gi rnam par shes pa dri za nye bar len pa'i rnam par shes pa zhig ma'i mngal du zhugs zla dgu ngo dang bcu'i bar du (361)mngal du bzung nas ma'i lus kyi bcud dang kha zas kyi dwangs ma thams cad bu'i lte ba nas brgyud de mar me la sdong skya bzhag pa bzhin du bskyed/ gnyis pa srog byin pa'i drin dran pa ni/ phyi skye ba na/ shi bo red zer na dbug ma chad/ gson po red zer na mgo mi thog pa zhig yin pa la drin mo che des 'chi rgyu 'chi ma bcug rgyus rgyu skam ma bcug par/ phrug ma phyis/ lte thag bcad/ 'o ma'i chu rgyun dron mos bkrus te 'chi ma bcug pa'i tshul bsam/ gsum pa yo byad bstan pan drin ni/ kha na zas med/ lag na nor med/ rgyab na gos med pa zhig yin pa/ dang po mngar ba'i nu zho bsnun/ sha drod la bcar/ de nas zas khas bsnyod/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ 'grang rtog lag pas tshod bzung*/ snab lud khas gzhib/ shin tu brtse bas drin gyis bskyang*/ zas kyi phud byin/ dmar gyi drung bstabs/ sdig pa sdug bsngal gnyis sgo nas bsags pa'i longs spyod thams cad bu la byin/ bu 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi bde ba la 'khod par che song (362)bsam rgyu med par yo byad bstabs/ bzhi pa 'jig rten bstan pa'i drin ni/ za mi shes pa la za lob/ smra mi shes pa smra lob/ 'gro lob gyon lob/ gos kyi mgo mjug ska rag gi sgrog lugs/ lham sgrog gi dam lhod yan chad logs par bslab/ su dang mi mnyam pa med pa/ mnyam gnyis gong gi rgyal po lta bu mas bslab/ chung phud bu tsam pa chen po g.yag tsam gyi bar du/ nya ka ba/ ba spu sdong po'i ma song bar bskyed pa'i drin dran/ gnyis pa chos kyi lugs la/ ma sems med na/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yul med/ bar du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa/ sbyin pa sbyin yul/

tshul khrims srung yul/ bzod pa bsgom pa'i yul du gyur pa dang*/ mthar mngon par rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa yang ma sems can gyi drin yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis drin mnyam par/ gsum pa drin gzo 'dod ni/ de ltar drin gyis bskyang ba'i ma rgan des drin chen po de tsam gyis bskyang na/ rang gi phar drin lan ci yang (363)ma sod par drin lan log mjal kho na las ma byas pas/ da dran lan gcig bsab gos snyam nas/ sems can thams cad ma'i yul du snyoms zhing drin lan gzo 'dod pa zhig gi bar du btang snyoms bsgom pa yin/ bzhi pa sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom pa la/ ma rgan gyis bde ba 'dod dam sdug bsngal 'dod snyam na/ bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba ni dgra mi sha bo 'joms pa bzhin du mi sgrub/ sgrub kyang mi shes/ tshul bzhin du ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang yang bral bas/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyid nga mi ldan par gyur pa'i ma rgan sems can 'di bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang mi ldan par gyur pa'i ma rgan sems can 'di bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan par gyur cig bsam nas smon pa dang 'brel ba/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ bde ba rgyu 'bras gnyis dang ldan pa zhig ngas bya snyam pa'i dam bca' dang 'brel ba/ dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa ste byams pa bsgom pa/ yang ma rgan gyis me (364)stag ltung ba'am/ tsher ma zug pa tsam gyis mtshon 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal phra mo tshun chad mi 'dod kyang*/ lus kyis las na mi dge ba las/ ngag gi bshad na mi dge ba bshad/ sems kyis bsam na mi dge ba bsam nas/ zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu gyur pa sdug bsngal bden pa dngos su gnod/ kun 'byung bden pas brgyud de gnod nas/ tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal kyi skyel ma byas/

phyi ma'i sdug bsngal gyi bsu ma byas/ bar ro'i sdug bsngal gyis mtshams sbyar ba'i ma drin po che/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral bar gyur cig bral na ci ma rung*/ bral ba zhig ngas bya snyam nas/ kye ma kyi hud sogs/ bla ma rgyal ba sogs/ dpa' bo khyod la sogs kyis dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams snying rje tshad med yin/ ma rgan la/ da lta bde zhing skyid pa rigs dang yon tan gyi 'byor ba yod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ de rnams ma nyams ma god par/ mngon mtho nas sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ma bral na ci ma rung*/ mi 'bral bar (365)bdag ngas bya snyam nas/ dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams dga' ba tshad med bsgom tshul yin pas/ de rnams zur dang po'i khungs su tshad med bzhi bsgom tshul yin/ gnyis pa zur phyi ma shes rab kyi rjogs byang la dmigs pa ni/ ma rgan sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te gang la bkod na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa skyon kun zad yon tan kun rjogs/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god dgos/ da lta de'i nus pa mi 'dug pas dper na ma las rdum ma'i bu chus khyer ba dang 'dra bas/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de thob par bya/ bsam pa de sems bskyed mtshan nyid pa yin/ gzhan gnyis dbye ba tsam las mtshan nyid pa ma yin no/ de ltar sems can thams cad kyi don du rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i tshe du dge rtsa 'di sgrub snyam pa'i sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa dge rtsa thams cad zin dgos/ bar du dngos gzhi dmigs med dam pa/ rig stong ljon pa'i ye shes mi g.yo gsum gyis bsgom pas/ sgrol (366)pa'i rig pa chos sku ngos zin pa'i ngang nas rtsal gyi rnam rtog thams cad chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin rang bral lam rang zhig rang dag rang chad nas/ rang grol chen por nyams su blang*/ rjes dge rtsa thams cad blos gcig tu bsdus zhing bzlum ste rang gzhan sems can thams cad bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du bsngo bar bya'o/

bsngo ba'i tshul de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang sras 'jam dpal dbyangs rnams kyis 'khor gsum yong dag gi bsngo bas ji ltar bsngos pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'jam dpal dpa' bos sogs dang*/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sogs kyis bsngo'o/ zhes pa'ang rgya ri skal bzang nyi ma'i ngor pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis dben khrod ljon pa lung gi dga' tshal nas spel ba dge legs su gyur cig maṅga lam/// /
